title: Worker heartbeat in the run feed: activity lines every few minutes for each live worker
description: Operator, 2026-09-30: the hn6 cloud run's feed was silent 18+ minutes while all three workers were busy (model trace showed 97–128 calls each, running targeted tests and make gate). The feed records only state transitions, so busy looks like stuck. Add a periodic per-worker activity line to the run feed (every 2–5 min while a worker is live): model-call count and delta, the last tool call summarised, and how long ago it happened. Cloud: from the AI Gateway trace (stamped per tick; add timestamps to trace output too — today it has none). Local: from the session transcripts #99 already reads. watch/status/events and watchers then show quiet only when a worker is truly quiet. Build on ltg (hn6's worker activity work) once it lands; do not duplicate it.
acceptance_criteria: During a live run each active worker contributes an activity line to the feed at least every 5 minutes, with call counts and the last action and its age; ticfac cloud trace shows timestamps; a stuck worker's lines show no new calls
